headline: Madonsela Fires Back at Ramaphosa's Objection
script: Round two in the Ramaphosa impeachment drama! After the president objected to Advocate Thandazani Madonsela leading the case against him, Madonsela just clapped back — hard. In a letter to Parliament, he says every single fact Ramaphosa raised was already disclosed in writing back in July, before MPs even voted. He also shut down Ramaphosa's claim that he'd be acting like a judge, saying, quote, 'he decides nothing' — his job is just to gather evidence for the committee. Meanwhile, the committee voted to get a legal opinion anyway, with only the MK Party and EFF against more delay. Opposition MPs are calling this a stalling tactic. Why should you care? This isn't just legal drama — it's about whether the person under investigation gets to handpick who investigates him, right before your November vote.
why_it_matters: Young voters heading into the November municipal elections deserve to see whether accountability processes can move forward without the accused shaping the rules.
